issue_context.title: Parquet read with `streaming=True` shifts/drops rows
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl

df = pl.scan_parquet("bug.parquet")

df.group_by(
    pl.col("timestamp").dt.truncate("1mo").alias("period")
).agg(
    pl.col("score").len(),
).collect(
    streaming=True
).sort(
    by="period"
)
```

### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

The streaming engine produces inconsistent results on a simple operation (`pl.col(...).len()`) in v1.7.1 (and 1.7.0, although that was yanked). I confirmed that the erroneous behavior does not exist in 1.5.0 or 1.6.0.

Unfortunately I cannot share the underlying parquet that produced this error. I tried to reproduce with some generated data but was unable to come up with an example that demonstrated the bug. I will do my best to assist debugging though.

### Expected behavior

The streaming engine and the non-streaming engine should produce the same output.

### Installed versions

comments:
Can reproduce. (Using lineitem.parquet from tpch)

```python
pl.scan_parquet('lineitem.parquet').select(pl.len()).collect(streaming=True).item()
# 6001215

pl.scan_parquet('lineitem.parquet').select(pl.len()).collect(streaming=False).item()
# 6001215
```

```python
pl.scan_parquet('lineitem.parquet').collect(streaming=True).height
# 6001204

pl.scan_parquet('lineitem.parquet').collect(streaming=False).height
# 6001215
```


**Update:**

I was testing on lineitem, it seems `3000000` is the minimum row number where it happens for me.

```python
import duckdb

duckdb.sql("LOAD tpch")
duckdb.sql("CALL dbgen(sf=1)")
duckdb.sql("from lineitem limit 3000000").pl().write_parquet("lineitem.parquet")
```

Then when reading, I get a `.height` mismatch:

2999997 # streaming=True
3000000 # streaming=False

It only happens if I write the parquet file with Polars.

Creating the file from duckdb directly does not replicate the issue.
Ai.. Could someone get a bisect on this one?
My guess is that is again a Parquet issue... I will see if I can find an MRE and solve it.

This seems to be the commit where it changes for me:

- https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/18584

It seems like it may have something to do with the number of row groups.

```python
pl.DataFrame({"id": range(31)}).write_parquet("18739.parquet", row_group_size=2)

print(pl.scan_parquet("18739.parquet").collect(streaming=False).height)
print(pl.scan_parquet("18739.parquet").collect(streaming=True).height)
```
```
31
30
```

> This seems to be the commit where it changes for me:
> 
> https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/18584

Thanks a lot for the help here @cmdlineluser (as always :) )

@nameexhaustion can you take this regression next week?
